missing: A test someone can check showing which power stations actually trigger a clean shutdown on named NAS systems (Synology DSM, QNAP, TrueNAS/NUT) over USB, with the low-battery threshold, the firmware or NUT version that works, and current prices for more than one or two EcoFlow models.
why: The only major reviewer, TechRadar, is a single-product review that says it did not test compatibility with any computer. Two niche sites (racksandwatts, ComputingForGeeks) answer in part, naming EcoFlow River 3 models and citing NUT support, but neither shows a shutdown test. The rest are general Anker blog posts, an affiliate listicle, pages about regular UPS units, and four results with no text. A focused page with tested shutdown results, a model-by-NAS compatibility list and current prices would stand out.
